name: Karasuno
description: Increases Power Attack and Quick Attack by 10% for all players.

name: Nekoma
description: Increases Receive by 15% for all players.

name: Dateko
description: Increases Block by 15% for all players.

name: Aoba Johsai
description: Increases Power Attack by 15% for all players.

name: Shiratorizawa
description: Increases Awareness and Strength by 10% for all players.

name: Fukurodani
description: Team Morale increases by 20.

name: Inarizaki
description: Increases Strength and Defense by 5% for all players.

name: Eccentric Duo
description: Increases Quick Attack power and Awareness of Hinata and Kageyama.

name: Karasuno Geniuses
description: Increases Reflex and Receive of Nishinoya SP. When Nishinoya uses special, Kageyama UR gains 1 stack of Competitive Spirit. If special is a perfect play, the first spike (Power or Quick) after that has power increased by 20% of attacker's Power Attack.

name: Cherry Blossom Viewing
description: Increases Awareness of Kenma SP. Increases Quick Attack of Hinata SP when play is perfect.

name: Sun vs Moon
description: When an ally sets (Pass), their [Awareness] increases by 10%. Lasts until ball crosses net 2 times. If Shoyo Hinata (Hanami)'s Quick Attack becomes a perfect play, cooldown of <High Jump> is reduced by 2 net crossings. Kei Tsukishima (Fireworks) receives [Awareness] equal to 50% of Hinata (Hanami)'s [Awareness], up to +50%. This effect lasts until ball crosses net 4 times.

name: After School
description: Increases Reflex of Nishinoya SP; when his Stamina is low, increases further.

name: Guardian Deity and Ace
description: When Nishinoya SSR or Azumane SSR use skill, both increase Attack Technique and Defense Technique.

name: Kiyoko's Squad
description: On scoring, increases Team Morale.

name: Brain and Commander
description: When Kenma SSR sets, Kuroo UR performs a strengthened Quick Attack.

name: Educational Guidance
description: Increases Receive of Yaku SSR and Quick Attack of Lev SSR.

name: Swimming
description: Increases Team Morale. With Morale active, increases Reflex of allies in double or triple blocks.

name: The Silent and The Sarcastic
description: Allows Aone SSR and Futakuchi SSR to use [Double Block] skill.

name: The New Captain and The Tall Rookie
description: Increases Block of front row players.

name: Perfect Harmony
description: When Oikawa UR sets, Iwaizumi SSR spikes with increased Power Attack. Gains 2 stacks of [Attack Rhythm], each increasing team Awareness by 1% (max 10).

name: The Pack
description: Increases Power Attack of Iwaizumi SSR and Kentaro SSR.

name: Best Friends for Life
description: Increases Power Attack of Ushijima UR and Defense Technique of Tendo SSR.

name: Absolute Champion and Solid Setter
description: When Shirabu SSR sets, Ushijima UR spikes with 10% more power.

name: Shiratorizawa WS
description: Increases Power Attack of all present players.

name: Miraculous Ace and Caring Setter
description: Bokuto UR leaves depression. When Akaashi SSR sets and Bokuto UR spikes, increases Power Attack of this hit by 20% and raises Team Morale by 15.

name: Miraculous Ace and Caring Setter (SP)
description: Increases Set of Akaashi SP. With Morale active, increases Power Attack of Bokuto SP by 18% and Set of Akaashi SP by 5%.

name: Strength of Twins
description: When Atsumu UR sets and Osamu UR performs Quick Attack Minus Tempo, increases Quick Attack of this play. Increases Attack Technique by 15%. Attack cannot be blocked.

name: Head of Twins
description: Increases Attack Technique of Osamu UR. Increases stats of Kita SSR. At start of match, Atsumu gains 3 stacks of Perfect Set (+2% Set each, max 10). Kita SSR gains similar bonus in Receive (max 3). The first Quick Attack of twins in each set receives +[Quick Attack] × 12%.

name: Long Time Friends
description: Increases stats of Hoshiumi UR. Increases Block for front row players. Hoshiumi UR and Hirugami UR receive a buff.

name: Top Spiker and Top Libero
description: Sakusa UR increases his Power Attack. Komori UR increases his Receive. Increases allies' Receive by 20%.

name: Brain and Commander SP
description: When Kenma SP and Kuroo SP are on court, can use Brain and Commander quick attack skill.

name: Fireworks Festival
description: Main stats of allies increase by 6%. At end of each rally, applies [Rage] to opponent front row ([Power Attack]/[Quick Attack] -10%). Lasts until ball crosses net 8 times. If target has [Rage], applies [Distraction] instead ([Power Attack]/[Quick Attack] -20%). Also lasts until ball crosses net 8 times. [Distraction] cannot be removed.

name: Sports Festival
description: When an ally touches ball, consumes 1 [Stamina] and increases main stats of that member by 3%/3.5%/4%/4.5%/5% for 2 net crossings. If this ball touch is a [Block], that member's [Block] increases by additional +5% for 2 net crossings.

name: Training Camp Allies
description: Allies on court with [Block] skill receive +6%/7%/8%/9%/10% [Block]. Cooldown of <Blocking System> reduced by 2 net crossings. When an ally activates [Serve] skill, applies [Rage] to opponent back row ([Power Attack]/[Quick Attack] -10%) for 8 net crossings.

name: Iron Wall
description: When Koganegawa is on court, if at least 2 members of this Bond are present, Bond Skill activates. When allies execute double/triple block, front row allies receive [Defense Technique] +3%/4%/5%/6%/7% for 1 net crossing. When ally activates [Serve] skill, serve will not fail. During rallies where ally activates [Serve] skill, if allies execute double/triple block, gains 1 stack of [Powerful Block] and [Create Iron Wall] (only activates if corresponding member is on court).

name: King and Great King
description: Kageyama and Oikawa compete for Serve right, first to activate Serve skill wins. If Oikawa wins, Kageyama receives 'Performance' effect. Lasts 1 set. If Kageyama wins, each time Oikawa touches ball, Kageyama receives 1 stack of 'Competitive' effect. When Oikawa activates skill, Kageyama receives another 1 stack of 'Competitive'.

name: Breathing in Harmony
description: When Iwaizumi spikes ball set by Oikawa, attack has power of Iwaizumi's [Power Attack] x 360%. 2 - Iwaizumi receives [Performance] effect (Oikawa's skill 1). Lasts 1 set.

name: Aoba Johsai Rivals
description: When Ushijima SP and Oikawa SP are on court, Oikawa's [Set] and [Serve] increase. When Oikawa SP sets and Ushijima SP performs power attack, gains 1 stack of [Attack Rhythm].

name: Cultural Festival
description: When member on court has [Ball Possession] buff, Oikawa (Cultural Festival) and Ushijima (Cultural Festival) increase Stamina recovery of all team members by 2%. During rallies, when ball crosses net twice, all members on court receive +4% [Strength] and [Receive]. Stacks up to 4 times.

name: Lifelong Friend
description: When Ushijima SP receives negative effect, Tendo SP's [Block] and [Quick Attack] increase by 4%. Max 12%. When Tendo SP's block results in superior play, Ushijima SP's Power Attack increases by [Power Attack] × 10%. Lasts 1 rally.

name: Winter Vacation
description: If Atsumu SP and Osamu SP are separated between front and back lines, both increase [Strength] by 30%. At end of each rally, Tendo SP's [Awareness] reduced to 0 and [Defense Technique] increases by 10%. Stacks up to 3 times. When Tendo SP touches ball first time each rally, always critical. Start of rally, [Attack Technique] and [Defense Technique] of all team members increase by 2% × number of (Winter Vacation) members. Max 12%.

name: Strongest Twins in High School
description: At start of match, Osamu SP gains 1 stack of [Ingenuity]. After Atsumu SP and Osamu SP play 1 set each, allies' [Attack Technique] and [Defense Technique] increase by 12.5%. Lasts 1 rally.
